summary: Tested PDF header/footer stamping and Equipment Wizard client search. Found CRITICAL BUG: PDF pages 1-5 have DOUBLED header/footer text due to both _header_footer() callback and stamp_header_footer_on_all_pages() adding overlays. Pages 6-9 (annexes) are correct. Equipment Wizard client search is working correctly with dynamic filtering.

critical.issue: PDF pages 1-5 have DOUBLED header/footer text. Both _header_footer() callback in doc.build() AND stamp_header_footer_on_all_pages() are adding overlays, causing text like 'CCoottiizzaacciioonn' instead of 'Cotizacion'. Pages 6-9 (annexes) are correct because they only get stamp_header_footer_on_all_pages() overlay.
critical.root_cause: In pdf_generator.py lines 899, 1304, 1650: doc.build(elements, onFirstPage=self._header_footer, onLaterPages=self._header_footer) adds header/footer to generated pages. Then stamp_header_footer_on_all_pages() in routes/quotes.py adds ANOTHER overlay on ALL pages.
critical.fix: Remove _header_footer callback from doc.build() calls. Change to: doc.build(elements) and let stamp_header_footer_on_all_pages() handle ALL header/footer stamping.

issues: React hydration warning: <tr> cannot be child of <span>, <span> cannot be child of <tbody>. This is a minor issue but should be fixed for clean console.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix PDF double header/footer by removing _header_footer callback from doc.build() in pdf_generator.py lines 899, 1304, 1650. Change to: doc.build(elements) without onFirstPage/onLaterPages callbacks.

3. Observe pages 1-5 have doubled text (e.g., 'CCoottiizzaacciioonn' instead of 'Cotizacion')
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Two overlapping header/footer mechanisms: (1) _header_footer() callback in doc.build() adds header/footer during PDF generation for pages 1-5, (2) stamp_header_footer_on_all_pages() adds another overlay on ALL pages. This causes double text on pages 1-5.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Remove onFirstPage=self._header_footer and onLaterPages=self._header_footer from doc.build() calls in pdf_generator.py (lines 899, 1304, 1650). Let stamp_header_footer_on_all_pages() handle ALL header/footer stamping uniformly.
